info.name: Mixpanel Data Pipelines API
info.description:
API for creating, managing, and monitoring data export pipelines in Mixpanel, including creating, editing, pausing, resuming, and deleting pipelines that export data to cloud storage and data warehouses.

Contact Support:
 Name: Mixpanel Support
 Email: support@mixpanel.com
